license_required.quote: No person within the purview of this chapter shall act, or assume to act, or advertise, as general engineering contractor, general building contractor, or specialty contractor without a license previously obtained under and in compliance with this chapter and the rules and regulations of the contractors license board.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of commerce and consumer affairs.

age_minimum.quote: Any individual unless the individual is age eighteen years or more;

moral_character_required.quote: Any person who does not possess a history of honesty, truthfulness, financial integrity, and fair dealing;

required.quote: Any person unless the person meets the experience requirements as prescribed in the board's rules; provided that the board may accept experience acquired on a self-employed or unlicensed basis if the experience can be verified;

experience_source.quote: Any person unless the person meets the experience requirements as prescribed in the board's rules;

kind.value: construction experience as prescribed by board rules
kind.quote: Any person unless the person meets the experience requirements as prescribed in the board's rules; provided that the board may accept experience acquired on a self-employed or unlicensed basis if the experience can be verified;

exams.name: Written examination
exams.notes: The board determines scope, length, format (oral, written, or both), and passing score; may contract with a professional testing service.
exams.quote: Any person unless the person has successfully passed a written examination as prescribed by the board;

interval_years.quote: The biennial renewal fee or inactive license fee, and the recovery fund, education fund, and compliance resolution fund fees shall be paid to the board on or before September 30 of each even-numbered year.

available.quote: Provide proof of licensure as a contractor in another state with similar contractor licensing requirements as those in this State, that the license is current, and that it has been in good standing for the past two years;

requirements.value: Emergency licensure by endorsement available during declared state of emergency/disaster when board determines shortage of HI licensed contractors exists; applicant must show current out-of-state license in good standing for 2 years, provide proof of liability/property damage insurance, workers' compensation insurance, a financial statement, applicable fees, state tax clearance, and bond.
requirements.quote: Provide proof of licensure as a contractor in another state with similar contractor licensing requirements as those in this State, that the license is current, and that it has been in good standing for the past two years;

regulatory_model.quote: No person within the purview of this chapter shall act, or assume to act, or advertise, as general engineering contractor, general building contractor, or specialty contractor without a license previously obtained under and in compliance with this chapter

credential_type.quote: Grant licenses, including conditional licenses, to contractors pursuant to this chapter and rules;

is_mandatory.quote: No person within the purview of this chapter shall act, or assume to act, or advertise, as general engineering contractor, general building contractor, or specialty contractor without a license previously obtained under and in compliance with this chapter

title_protection.quote: It is a misdemeanor for any person, including a person who is exempt by section 444-2 from this chapter, to advertise with or without any limiting qualifications as a contractor unless such person holds a valid license under this chapter for the goods and services advertised.

scope_protection.quote: No person within the purview of this chapter shall act, or assume to act, or advertise, as general engineering contractor, general building contractor, or specialty contractor without a license previously obtained under and in compliance with this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any dishonest, fraudulent, or deceitful act as a contractor that causes substantial damage to another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any dishonest, fraudulent, or deceitful act as a contractor that causes substantial damage to another;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any unfair or deceptive act or practice as prohibited by section 480-2.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any unfair or deceptive act or practice as prohibited by section 480-2;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of any construction project or operation without reasonable or legal excuse.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of any construction project or operation without reasonable or legal excuse;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wilful diversion of funds or property received for prosecution or completion of a specific construction project and use thereof for any other purpose.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful diversion of funds or property received for prosecution or completion of a specific construction project or operation, or for a specified purpose in the prosecution or completion of any construction project or operation, and the use thereof for any other purpose;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wilful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without consent of the owner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful departure from, or wilful disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without consent of the owner or the owner's duly authorized representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wilful violation of any law of the State or county relating to building, including applicable rules of the department of health or safety or labor law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful violation of any law of the State, or any county, relating to building, including any violation of any applicable rule of the department of health, or of any applicable safety or labor law;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make and keep records of all contracts, documents, records, receipts, and disbursements for not less than three years after project completion.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to make and keep records showing all contracts, documents, records, receipts, and disbursements by a licensee of all the licensee's transactions as a contractor for a period of not less than three years after completion of any construction project or operation

disciplinary_grounds.description: When a licensee that is a partnership or joint venture permits an unlicensed partner or employee to have direct management of the contracting business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the licensee being a partnership or a joint venture permits any partner, member, or employee of the partnership or joint venture who does not hold a license to have the direct management of the contracting business thereof;

disciplinary_grounds.description: When a licensee that is a corporation permits an unlicensed officer or employee to have direct management of the contracting business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the licensee being a corporation permits any officer or employee of the corporation who does not hold a license to have the direct management of the contracting business thereof;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant in obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant in obtaining a license;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensee to complete in a material respect any construction project or operation for the agreed price if the failure is without legal excuse.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to complete in a material respect any construction project or operation for the agreed price if the failure is without legal excuse;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wilful failure in any material respect to comply with this chapter or the rules adopted pursuant thereto.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful failure in any material respect to comply with this chapter or the rules adopted pursuant thereto;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wilful failure or refusal to prosecute a project or operation to completion with reasonable diligence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful failure or refusal to prosecute a project or operation to completion with reasonable diligence;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wilful failure to pay when due a debt for services or materials rendered in connection with operations as a contractor when the licensee has the ability to pay.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful failure to pay when due a debt incurred for services or materials rendered or purchased in connection with the licensee's operations as a contractor when the licensee has the ability to pay

disciplinary_grounds.description: False denial of any debt or its validity with intent to secure a discount or to hinder, delay, or defraud the person to whom the debt is due.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The false denial of any debt due or the validity of the claim therefor with intent to secure for a licensee, the licensee's employer, or other person, any discount of the debt or with intent to hinder, delay, or defraud the person to whom the debt is due;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to secure or maintain workers' compensation insurance (unless authorized to self-insure or excluded).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to secure or maintain workers' compensation insurance, unless the licensee is authorized to act as a self-insurer under chapter 386 or is excluded from the requirements of chapter 386;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into a contract with an unlicensed contractor involving work for which licensing is required under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into a contract with an unlicensed contractor involving work or activity for the performance of which licensing is required under this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing service on a residential or commercial air conditioner using CFCs without using refrigerant recovery and recycling equipment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing service on a residential or commercial air conditioner using CFCs without using refrigerant recovery and recycling equipment;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing service on any air conditioner after January 1, 1994, without successful completion of an appropriate training course in recovery and recycling of CFC and HCFC refrigerants.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing service on any air conditioner after January 1, 1994, without successful completion of an appropriate training course in the recovery and recycling of CFC and HCFC refrigerants

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating chapter 342C (ozone layer protection).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating chapter 342C;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay delinquent taxes, interest, and penalties under chapter 237 relating to the business of contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay delinquent taxes, interest, and penalties assessed under chapter 237 that relate to the business of contracting, or to comply with the terms of a conditional payment plan with the department of taxation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or intentionally employing a person to perform work under a contract subject to chapter 104 who is not eligible to work in the United States under federal law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or intentionally employing a person to perform work under a contract subject to chapter 104 who is not eligible to work in the United States under federal law.

bonding_required.quote: Any person unless the person submits a bond if required by the board under section 444-16.5.

insurance_required.quote: Any person unless the person submits satisfactory proof to the board that the person has obtained liability insurance;

definition_quote.value: "Contractor" means any person who by oneself or through others offers to undertake, or holds oneself out as being able to undertake, or does undertake to alter, add to, subtract from, improve, enhance, or beautify any realty or construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck, or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, excavation, or other structure, project, development, or improvement, or do any part thereof, including the erection of scaffolding or other structures or works in connection therewith.
definition_quote.quote: "Contractor" means any person who by oneself or through others offers to undertake, or holds oneself out as being able to undertake, or does undertake to alter, add to, subtract from, improve, enhance, or beautify any realty or construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck, or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, excavation, or other structure, project, development, or improvement, or do any part thereof, including the erection of scaffolding or other structures or works in connection therewith.

methods_authorized.quote: For the purpose of classification, the contracting business includes any or all of the following branches: (1) General engineering contracting; (2) General building contracting; (3) Specialty contracting.

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: A contractor may advertise in print or broadcast medium, as defined in subsection (a) only if the contractor includes in the advertisement or listing the contractor's applicable and current license number

self_insurance_permitted.quote: Any person unless the person submits satisfactory proof to the board that the person has obtained workers' compensation insurance, or has been authorized to act as a self-insurer under chapter 386 or is excluded from the requirements of chapter 386;

contract_must_be_written.quote: All licensed contractors performing home construction or improvements shall provide a written contract to the homeowner.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: Any project or operation for which the aggregate contract price for labor and materials is not more than $1,500.

enhanced_penalty_for_elderly_victims.quote: If any person is found to have violated section 444-9 and the violation is committed against elderly persons, in addition to any other penalty set forth or imposed, the court may impose a fine of up to $20,000, or imprisonment up to one year, or both.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: The biennial renewal fee or inactive license fee, and the recovery fund, education fund, and compliance resolution fund fees shall be paid to the board on or before September 30 of each even-numbered year.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: Any violation of this section shall be deemed an unfair or deceptive practice and shall be subject to provisions of chapter 480

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: The failure of any person to comply with any provision of this chapter shall prevent such person from recovering for work done, or materials or supplies furnished, or both on a contract or on the basis of the reasonable value thereof, in a civil action, if such person failed to obtain a license under this chapter prior to contracting for such work.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
